surface_mechanism_description: The surface reaction mechanism involves the formation of ZnFe2O4 through the interaction of ZnO and Fe2O3 layers, where Zn2+ ions diffuse into the bulk of the iron oxide to form the spinel phase. The mechanism requires a mobile ZnO phase on the surface of Fe2O3 as well as partial oxygen loss and reoxidation.
evidence: It requires a mobile ZnO phase on the surface of Fe2O3 as well as partial oxygen loss and reoxidation. Zn2+ ions diffuse into the bulk of the iron oxide to form the spinel phase.
